android_mechanism: History persisted eagerly on every change; fix defers the save
bug_description: The search-history HistoryStore calls preferences flush() synchronously on every setItem/delItem (i.e., on every recorded search keyword), forcing a disk write on the caller's thread each time. Rapid successive searches each pay a full synchronous flush, adding avoidable I/O latency to the search flow.
fix_summary: Flushes are debounced: mutations update the in-memory cache synchronously and a single flush runs 2 seconds after the last mutation.
trigger_steps: Launch the app and open the search page.
Start hitrace capture (categories: app, sched, disk, filesystem).
Submit 10 different keyword searches in quick succession.
Stop hitrace after 5s idle. Repeat 3 repetitions for unfixed, then install the fixed HAP and repeat 3 repetitions.

test_oracle.definition: Number of preference flush (fsync/disk write) operations attributable to the history store during a 10-search burst, and their total wall/CPU time from the disk trace.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed: 10 flushes (one per search) on the calling thread; fixed: 1 flush after the burst. unfixed disk-sync time on the search path > fixed by >= 5x for the burst.

trace_config.command: hdc shell hitrace --time 30 app sched disk filesystem -o /data/local/tmp/ia_flush.chtrace
